title: Tourism Explorer
description: Surfaces popular tourist attractions, landmarks, museums, monuments, viewpoints and other points of interest for a given city. Scoped to sights and attractions only - excludes restaurants, cafes, bars, shopping and lodging.

supportedIntents.description: Queries asking what to see or visit in a city. Handles generic attraction requests as well as requests scoped to a specific kind of sight such as museums, landmarks, monuments or viewpoints.

attractionCategory.description: Kind of tourism point of interest requested, e.g. 'sight', 'landmark', 'museum', 'monument', 'viewpoint', 'historical site'.

schema.description: Main query object defining a tourism attraction request for a city.

type.description: Kind of request: 'list' to retrieve attractions for a city or 'query' for a category-filtered search.

city.description: Name of the city whose attractions are requested. Resolved by NER as an HD_LOCATION entity.

radius.description: Search radius in metres around the resolved city centre. Defaults to 5000.
